resources.name: LAMMPS molecular dynamics package
resources.notes: LAMMPS is used for generating training data and performing single relaxations of predicted configurations. Any version supporting EAM potentials and static minimization is acceptable.

resources.name: scikit-learn
resources.notes: Python library for SVR with Gaussian (RBF) kernel. Install via pip install scikit-learn.

resources.name: Cu EAM potential (Cleri & Rosato 1991)

access.notes: Available from NIST Interatomic Potentials Repository or bundled with LAMMPS.

resources.notes: Embedded-atom method potential for Cu, used in static-lattice energy calculations.

resources.name: NumPy, SciPy, pandas

access.notes: Install via pip install numpy scipy pandas

resources.notes: Required for descriptor computation, data handling, and output CSV writing.

resources.name: Grain boundary geometry definitions (CSL parameters)

access.notes: The paper specifies Σ values and plane indices; the agent constructs supercells using standard Cu FCC lattice and CSL theory.

resources.notes: The agent must construct the atomic supercells for each boundary type using standard Cu FCC lattice and CSL misorientation/plane relationships, as described in the paper.
